limits: Runtime review is bounded to the changed component and inspected helpers; it is not a full application audit.
Durable writes already started may settle after cancellation, idle lock, session replacement or unmount; they are not canceled or rolled back.
The synchronous write token is component-instance ownership, with underlying storage CAS providing durable record safeguards.
Browser fixtures retain production KDF/native encryption but remain authored acceptance until an actual browser run.
